title: Hello world with dependencies
description: The application prints a greeting through an injected logger. Its entry point selects the providers, and each folder exposes a small public surface.

walkthrough.explanation: Startup binds the console, logger, and application, then resolves the greeter and calls it.
The greeter receives its logger in the header and delegates the greeting to it. The interface states the console effect.
This is the logging folder's public surface. Callers can import the exported contract and provider.
The contract describes the log operation and its output capability; the console provider implements it.

title: A small tested application

This is the contract used by both the production logger and the test adapter.
